lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
አንቀጸ ብርሃን ድንግል ማርያም
ሰማያዊ ዙፋን ናይ መድኃኔ ዓለም
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ሰማይ ኮነ ምድሪ ከቶ ዘይጾርዎ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]አረ ንመለኮት ከመይ ክኢልክዮ /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]መጋረጃ ሓዊ ናበይ ተጋረደ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ብዘደንቕ ጥበብ ምሳኺ ተዋሃደ /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ናይ ኪሩቤል ኣምሳል ድንግል ብምዃንኪ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ሰማያዊ ንጉሥ ወጺኡ ካባኺ /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ናይ መለኮት ዙፋን ድንግል ብምዃንኪ /2/[[/highlight]]
ሚካኤል ገብርኤል መጺኦም ሰገዱልኪ
ሩፋኤል ራጉኤል መጺኦም ሰገዱልኪ

[[highlight]]ክብሪ ከም ናይ ሙሴ /2/[[/highlight]]
ሕያውነት ከም ኣብርሃም
ጥበብ ከም ሰሎሞን
[[highlight]]ንሃገርና ኤርትራ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ሃባ ኦ ጐይታና /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
ʾAnqetse birhan dingil Maryam
Semayawi zufan nay medhane ʿalem
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]Semay kone midri keto zeytsorwo /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ʾAre nimelekot kemey kiʾilkiyo /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Megareja hawi nabey tegarede /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Bizedenqh t'ibeb misakhi tewahade /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Nay kirubel ʾamsal dingil bimkhwanki /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Semayawi nigus wetsiʾu kabakhi /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Nay melekot zufan dingil bimkhwanki /2/[[/highlight]]
Mikaʾel Gebriʾel metsiʾom segedulki
Rufaʾel raguʾel metsiʾom segedulki

[[highlight]]Kibri kem nay Muse /2/[[/highlight]]
Hiyawnet kem ʾAbriham
T'ibeb kem Selomon
[[highlight]]Nihagerna ʾertira /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Haba ʾo goytana /2/[[/highlight]]
